rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Speaking as 内閣総理大臣 (菅直人君) in his policy speech of 11 June 2010, he said that he had now, by the Diet's designation, come to bear the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister (このたび、国会の指名により、内閣総理大臣の重責を担うこととなりました); no day is given.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
